turns.question: Which 8-K filings from February and March 2026 report entering into or terminating a material definitive agreement under Item 1.01 or 1.02? Summarize three of the agreements, and cite the filings.

report.markdown:
Based on the SEC filings data, here are three 8-K filings from February and March 2026 reporting entry into or termination of material definitive agreements under Item 1.01 or 1.02:

| Company (Ticker) | Filing Date | Item | Agreement Summary |
|------------------|-------------|------|-------------------|
| **Salesforce, Inc. (CRM)** | March 12, 2026 (event: March 11, 2026) | **1.01** | Entered into **accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreements** with Banco Santander, Bank of America, Citibank, JPMorgan Chase Bank, and other counterparties to repurchase up to $20 billion of common stock. Also entered into a **Five-Year Credit Agreement** with a syndicate of lenders led by JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent. [1] |
| **Netflix, Inc. (NFLX)** | February 27, 2026 | **1.02** | **Terminated the Merger Agreement** (dated December 4, 2025, amended January 19, 2026) with Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) and related entities after WBD entered into a superior proposal with another party (PSKY). Netflix received a **$2.8 billion termination fee** from WBD/PSKY. Related financing commitments (bridge facility, revolving credit, delayed-draw term loan) were automatically terminated. [2] |
| **Amgen Inc. (AMGN)** | February 19, 2026 (event: February 17, 2026) | **1.01** | **Issued and sold $4.0 billion of senior notes** in four tranches: $1.0B of 4.200% Notes due 2031, $1.75B of 4.850% Notes due 2036, $500M of 5.500% Notes due 2046, and $750M of 5.650% Notes due 2056. Net proceeds of ~$3.96B after discounts and expenses. Notes issued under an existing indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company as trustee. [3] |

**Notes**
- The SEC filings source covers 8-Ks for the 100 most liquid stocks and all Item 1.05 cybersecurity filings from January 2, 2025 – March 12, 2026. The three examples above are drawn from that set and fall within the requested February–March 2026 window.
- Each filing cites its SEC accession number and the specific Item (1.01 for entry, 1.02 for termination) in the metadata returned by the retrieval tool.
